prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. A single premium cinematic live action reference still, vertical 9:16, highest available native detail, not a collage. Inputs: image 1 is the precise edit target for the two adult characters, clothing, handheld props and near-door upper platform; image 2 ONLY supplies the sliding narrow door geometry, NOT its extra illuminated decorations; image 3 supplies the old straight iron sword/scabbard and dark bronze three-curve boss token; images 4 and 5 lock original faces. Create the next state four seconds later: the pair have advanced a small half step together toward the same door, staying OUTSIDE on the upper landing flush with the threshold, no staircase between their feet and threshold. A black-gold man is screen LEFT, B silver-blue barefoot woman screen RIGHT. A's anatomical LEFT palm holds the same small bronze token; B's anatomical RIGHT palm holds the same compact tied silver cloth knot. Objects remain separated by ONE PALM width in empty air and do not touch each other or the door. A's right arm still lowered empty; intact old sword is FULLY SHEATHED on his back. B's left arm lowered empty; original small plain brown leather short knife sheath on her right waist. No rope, no extra token at A's waist while token held. Retain tiny traces of dried blood on A right hand and B left index, no extra injuries. Both pivot their torsos/head slightly toward doorway, attentive rather than posing.
Open only a central vertical narrow slot about 12 cm wide by translating the original two door leaves sideways slightly, never swinging, never making a human-sized passage. Dark blue interior floor is continuous across the shallow threshold, no shaft/trap and no person inside. Lighting is critical: exactly ONE fine outermost circular track glows thin warm amber. On the two separated leaves it has a small gap at center where the door opens. The track is lit for THREE QUARTERS of the original circle: start at 12 o'clock and go CLOCKWISE through right upper, right lower, left lower, ending at 9 o'clock. Upper LEFT quarter 9-to-12 remains completely DARK. Do NOT light a wide band, star glyphs, inner concentric lines, centre spokes or door perimeter. No luminous line through opaque bodies. Frame large enough from head to bare feet/boots and ring to read light pattern, central gap and upper-landing foot positions. Preserve original grey stone, graphite door and dark bronze detailing; intact finely crafted maintained surfaces with mild age, no blanket pits/rust/moss or rubbish, low saturation dawn warm side light with cold blue slot, no rainbow palace. No extra people, no weapon draw yet, no stone flying yet, no lettering, no subtitle, no logo/watermark. This is a limited static intermediate target, NOT a video or proof of contact/load.

Back empty scabbard cropped above is not a new hilt.
Door leaves still narrowly separated, not full open or rotated; continuous solid floor to inside and outside, no shaft/step/stair between.
